csv_project_name: Dev for Commercial Aviation Related Development
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Chandler ( City ) is soliciting development proposals from qualified individuals or firms ( Offeror or Offerors ) interested in providing commercial aviation related development and aeronautical services facilities to support general aviation activities at Chandler Municipal Airport ( CHD or Airport , respectively). upport general aviation activities at Chandler Municipal Airport ( CHD or Airport , respectively). This would include facilities for any Special Aeronautical Service Operations (SASO) as identified in the Minimum Operating Standards portion of the Chandler Airport Rules and Regulations (R&R). Part I of the R&R consists of the General Provisions for operating on the Airport. Part II of the R&R consists of the Minimum Operating Standards for performing commercial activity on the Airport.
